model_variant_experiments.locator_note: A quoted qualified locator ("System.Diagnostics.Process.Start") is refused with qualified-call-locator-ambiguous when the declared family mixes the instance Start() with static overloads, even under a model_id filter. An all-static family is accepted, as are instance-only families such as SignedXml.CheckSignature; a scratch SignedXml copy with one overload made static was refused the same way. The probes therefore name members by model id.
